title: Null control: Iran conflict vs JETS
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Iran conflict-event 20d z-score > 1.5 should NOT move the broad airline ETF JETS if the AAL effect is Gulf-route specific (-); trade short JETS 3d at 1d lag [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0062)
message: Null control holds: Iran conflict z-score barely moves JETS (r=-0.10, n=390, validity 0, supported_prob 0); short JETS rule loses in-sample (62 trades, -0.21%/trade), weak +0.25% OOS on 21 trades - AAL effect looks Gulf-route specific, not broad-airline.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short JETS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Spread check: if Iran conflict-event 20d z-score > 1.5 hits Gulf-route carriers but not the broad airline ETF, the same signal should widen JETS realised range (volatility) without directional drift (+); trade long JETS range 3d at 1d lag [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.JETS.range_pct] (parent: R2-0162)
